test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is In fact.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Of course- Used **to introduce an idea** or action as being obvious or to be expected.

 
 
• *Example: The point is of course that the puzzle itself is misleading.*
 
 
 
• Despite- Used to link two contrasting ideas or show that one fact makes the other fact surprising.
 
 
• *Example: Despite the rain, we enjoyed the festival.*
 
 
 
• In fact- Used **to emphasize the truth of an assertion**, especially one contrary to what might be expected or what has been asserted.
 
 
• *Example: We've had a pretty bad time while you were away. In fact, we very nearly split up this time. *
 
 
 
• As a result- **Used as a conjunctive adverbial phrase** to indicate cause-and-effect relationships.
 
 
• *Example: He sprained his wrist and, as a result, he will not be playing in the tournament. *
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is 'in fact'.
 
• Therefore option 1 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: The whole village, 'in fact' has been tidied up so much that it looks no more picturesque than any suburban street.
